description: PROPOSED by F2-MIGRATION-W53 (Wave 2 Batch 6, seat W53) - NOT yet the loader's contract. Replaces the legacy bare-object plates.json ({name: [x0, y0]}), whose only loadable keys were the five plate names hardcoded at src/film.rs:2060. In the migrated shape the manifest IS the plate set: the loader loads exactly the entries listed, each with an explicit file and an explicit origin. Envelope precedent: scenes/film/film.json carries format/version keys. Entry order is load order (the legacy loader's hardcoded array order is preserved in the migrated data). additionalProperties:false is the checker-side contract (tools/format/check_assets.py check 5, re-pointed per F2-MIGRATION-W53 step T1); the Rust loader itself ignores unknown keys today (gap F3) - the schema is the ratchet, not a loader claim.

format.description: Format tag. A plates.json without this tag is the legacy bare-object shape; the migrated loader rejects it by name (F2-MIGRATION-W53 section 3, fallback FB1) instead of silently loading zero plates.

plates.description: The film's complete plate set. Every entry is loaded (blocking, before any frame or verdict work - src/film.rs load_assets runs first in both --film and --film-telemetry). A plate the staging names but the manifest lacks is no longer masked by a hardcoded list; a manifest entry no staging names is loaded but never drawn (plate_of lookup is by name, src/film.rs:2223-2227).

file.description: Assets-relative PNG basename; the loader joins it onto <DIR>/assets exactly as it joins caption strips today. Explicit so the plate set is no longer bound to the {name}.png derivation at src/film.rs:2061 - a plate's lookup name and its file name may differ.

name.description: Staging lookup key: the string the shot staging passes as hold_l/hold_r (src/film.rs CharDraw plate names, resolved at src/film.rs:2223-2227 into src/toonfull.rs Plate). Must be unique across the array - duplicates are a load error in the migrated loader (today's HashMap insert would silently overwrite).

origin.description: [x0, y0]: the stage-local coordinate of the plate image's top-left corner relative to the hand point the PropFn receives (src/toonfull.rs:113-114; the plate is RGBA pixels at res 2 in stage units, corners at hand + (x0, y0) .. hand + (x0 + w/2, y0 + h/2), src/toonfull.rs:233-235). REQUIRED with no default: the legacy (0, 0) silent default (src/film.rs:2062-2069) is the defect this field's requiredness kills (F2-MIGRATION-W53 section 3, fallback FB2).

version.description: Manifest shape version. 1 is the first versioned shape; the legacy shape was never versioned.

title: TaleRender film plates manifest (assets/plates.json, migrated shape)
